SELECT 
  SUM(qty * unit_price_orig * fx_rate) AS sep_cad_cost,
  SUM(qty * unit_price_orig) * 1.3875 AS aug_fx_based_cost,
  SUM(qty * unit_price_orig * fx_rate) - SUM(qty * unit_price_orig) * 1.3875 AS fx_effect
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line
WHERE currency='USD' AND period='2026-09'
